subject.name: shiploop
mission: ShipLoop is a delivery harness whose scripts own navigation and prompts: the model does one step at a time, and what a run delivered is read from files, not from what the model says.

ShipLoop's E2E harness (test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md) is the contract a run is scored against: accuracy, enterprise and fidelity floors first, then efficiency, and an improver may change only the candidate, never what grades it.
A finding is acted on only when a script-run test or a measured epoch shows the change helped; a model's judgment never promotes a change.

routine: run the allowlisted cases (hello, csv-report, seat-reservations, battleship) on the pinned subject profile
build the plugin, run the quick tier, and qualify candidates through the harness's own loop
owner_only: any case that requires a browser, a platform or a base repository
recording a decision on a learning record (the facade's decide verb)
